cases.title: Moving a pit with MOVE opens no CE window, its label, cover text and invert texts follow, and one U puts everything back
cases.plan_item: quick MOVE (gap plan section 3 item 7; spec C37-C41 regressions; backlog W1-02)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 24 Oct 2026 with card C41 (TEST_CASES_DRAFT_22OCT.md) and robot run 47 B.4.1. Same MOVE and U steps. Batch 6 (28 Oct 2026, Codex cx_cr03 and cx_cr21): how far the pit label, the cover text and the four IL texts 1155B6, 116A3C, 116BE4 and 116A0E move is now ASSERTED (2000 mm +- 150), not only recorded; the positions of the pit, the label, the cover text and all six IL texts are read unrounded before and after the U and must match to 0.001 mm (the card's tolerance). The card's 'documented placement rules' for linked labels are still not recorded anywhere, so how far each text should move beyond 2000 +- 150 is not judged.
cases.expected: Pick pit P3 (handle 109D56, at 53777.7,-25569.9), run MOVE with displacement 0,0 to 0,2000: AutoCAD says '1 found', the pit's insertion point is now 2000 mm higher (Y -23569.9, X unchanged), no Edit Pit, Edit Pipe, New Pit, New Pipe or Cascade window opened, and one U (echo word MOVE) puts the pit back at Y -25569.9.
cases.why_not_unit: Native MOVE has to drive CE's live link updates inside AutoCAD without a blocking window; only a live drawing shows the pit position and the window list afterwards.
not_automated: Phase 3 batch 2: the invert texts (IL) within 4000 mm of the pit (six on this drawing) are read before the move, at the pit's new place and after U, and must be the same six objects; two of them must have moved 2000 mm +- 150 (they follow the pit on 3.0.73, probe 24 Oct). Batch 4 (26 Oct): the pit's name label and cover text are read (moved and returned); the four IL texts 1155B6, 116A3C, 116BE4 and 116A0E (probe b4p1: 116A0E sits at 53026.75,-26891.46, IL 18.10, south-west of the pit) are read after the U and must be back within 0.5 mm of where they were; how far each moved is asserted at 2000 mm +- 150 (batch 6, 28 Oct 2026). The pipe ends are not read (a pipe returns only handle, object and layer through ent-read).
A CE message line about a label with no clear spot appears on this drawing after the move; it is recorded, not judged.
